methods.name: Exact quotient-root atlas and ternary state-count carry operator
capabilities: compute the exact state-specific coalescence horizon and high-denominator cutoff
certify the high injective chart and contiguous forced low-root chart
compute exact distinct quotient-root state cardinality without a full denominator scan
certify the unique optional horizon state by a binary boundary carry
compress the exact count to a three-valued threshold carry
materialize the compressed root-state atlas for regression or downstream finite reasoning
methods.core_law: For n>=1 and r>=1, with H=R_(r+1)(r*n-1) and D=floor(n/(H+1)^r), the quotient-root atlas R_r(floor(n/d)), 1<=d<=n, is the disjoint union of an injective D-state high chart and the forced low interval 1..H-1 plus at most the horizon H. Hence |S|+1=D+H+kappa; with q=floor(H/r) the three-point D-band compresses this to |S|+1=H+q+tau with tau in {0,1,2} selected by two exact thresholds.
methods.hard_boundary: DOMAIN_OPERATOR only. The carrier is the finite positive-denominator quotient-root atlas. Do not generalize to arbitrary floor maps or quotient semigroups, do not infer prime/factoring/Legendre or continuum claims, do not erase the H=0 branch, and do not treat the ternary state-count carry as a universal T5 carry law. No Foundation mutation follows.
